contract:
FOLD THIS SIGNAL (plain text, no em-dashes, under 150 words): the row below is a signal an estate captured. Answer three things only: (1) TRUE-TODAY: is this signal still true given everything else you know in the row's context - yes/no/unknown with one line of why; (2) THE ORGAN: which kind of organ should own this signal (a law, a clock, a gate, a memory row, or compost); (3) THE FALSIFIER: the observation that would prove the signal wrong. Mark unknowns UNKNOWN; do not pad.

SIGNAL: CONTEXT: A stateless, per-entry prior-root chain model where the ledger is defined as the longest valid prefix of entries starting from an immutable genesis. Each entry embeds the running root of all prior entries, and a "Seat" is an ephemeral worker that trusts only the pinned genesis and the latest external anchor. ROLE: Architect of a concrete, stateless verification mechanism for the described ledger model. TASK: Design a single, buildable verification mechanism that allows a Seat to validate the integrity of a candidate entry against the ledger without maintaining state. CONSTRAINTS: One
